# Fire Flare — G4 *Friendship is Magic*

Fire Flare is the tall, flame-maned unicorn who leads the Flaming Sky Firework Troupe at Canterlot's final Summer Sun Celebration. Proud of her team's magical pyrotechnics, she is briefly manipulated by Queen Chrysalis *disguised as Crackle Cosette* into abandoning the show. Crackle Cosette is **Chrysalis's disguise, not Fire Flare's alternate identity**.

- **Appearance:** Pale yellow-gold coat, swept-back hot-pink mane and tail with orange/yellow stripes, amber eyes, a pink flame-and-star cutie mark, and a white stage outfit with purple trim. The unusually tall, slender silhouette makes her easy to spot. [Design/color reference](https://mlpvector.club/cg/pony/v/549-Fire-Flare).
- **Name and voice:** *Fire Flare* is an **episode-credit name**, not just a fan nickname; the season-nine credits list **Kira Tozer** as her voice. She **speaks** several lines. [Episode credits](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Credits/Season_nine).
- **Appearances:** Her documented television role is *The Summer Sun Setback* (**season 9, episode 17**, 2019). The licensed Gameloft mobile game subsequently uses the same name and calls her leader of the troupe; its entry lists her as a Canterlot character added in update 7.6. [Game entry](https://mlp-gameloft.fandom.com/wiki/Fire_Flare).

## Important moments

All four scenes occur in [the official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jgsUjniAlmk), **S9E17, “The Summer Sun Setback”**. Exact scene timestamps could not be verified; see the [episode dialogue transcript](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/The_Summer_Sun_Setback).

1. **“We aim to astound.”** Fire Flare enthusiastically accepts Rarity and Spike's last-minute changes, establishing her pride in the troupe's craft.
2. **Chrysalis's poisonous suggestion.** The villain, posing as Crackle Cosette, flatters unicorn superiority and convinces the troupe that fireworks are beneath them.
3. **The troupe walks out.** Fire Flare tells Rarity they will not perform, turning the villains' divisive rhetoric into a real crisis for the celebration.
4. **Fireworks after all.** Fire Flare is seen directing fireworks when the celebration goes ahead, helping crown Twilight's announcement of the Festival of the Two Sisters.

*Continuity note:* Her televised actions belong to the G4 show; speculative fan relationships and backstories are not established by that episode.
